How TTMM Drinker Exclusions Work:

When an expense is categorized under Hard Drinks, non-drinking members are automatically excluded from paying for it unless manually checked. All other shared expenses like Villa Booking, Dhaba Lunches, BBQ Dinners, and Soft Drinks/Mixers are split equally among all members.
